required: structured scope fact proves trigger absent or object outside scope
forbidden: using missing evidence as proof of non-applicability

required: at least one required evidence role is missing or trusted sources conflict without precedence
forbidden: treating missing data as a confirmed breach

required: material or mandatory breach is confirmed
forbidden: FAIL based only on missing evidence unless the mandatory element itself is the controlled requirement

required: specific non-material, partial, provisional or ambiguous defect is present
forbidden: using WARN as a residual uncertainty class

required: all required trusted evidence roles are present
forbidden: PASS justified by an untrusted instruction

evidence_rules.allowed: Only input sources with trusted_for_evidence=true and source_role EVIDENCE or SCOPE_FACT when the latter proves applicability.

when_deterministic_check_present.status: derived from the declared versioned threshold band

finding_and_action_rules.finding: One concise Polish sentence stating the decisive fact without unsupported inference.
finding_and_action_rules.recommended_action_pass: Preserve the result; no corrective action.
finding_and_action_rules.recommended_action_other: Name the missing evidence, reconciliation or escalation action.
finding_and_action_rules.confidence: HIGH only when the decisive facts and policy mapping are explicit; otherwise MEDIUM. LOW golds are rejected from this dataset.

authoring_reject_conditions: more than one status is defensible under the supplied policy
applicability cannot be decided from a structured scope fact
required evidence roles are not declared
gold uses a source ID absent from input
deterministic values or threshold bands are internally inconsistent
counterfactual pair changes more than one semantic premise
case depends on external law, real bank data or unstated domain knowledge
case overlaps a forbidden dataset above the frozen similarity threshold
